title: Slovakian Fried Dumplings
description: A hearty Slovakian dish featuring fried dumplings smothered in a rich, cheesy sauce.

ingredients.name: Cheese
ingredients.amount: 1 cup, grated (such as cheddar or mozzarella)

instructions: Heat butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add fried dumplings to the skillet and cook until browned on both sides, about 5 minutes.
In a separate saucepan, melt 1 tablespoon of butter over medium heat.
Add grated cheese and stir until melted and smooth.
Add milk, flour, salt, and black pepper to the cheese sauce, stirring constantly.
Bring the cheese sauce to a simmer and cook until thickened, about 2-3 minutes.
Pour the cheese sauce over the fried dumplings and toss to coat.
Sprinkle bread crumbs on top and serve hot.
